definitions.explanation: Formally including someone or something into an existing group, organization, or system. In education, it refers specifically to transferring into a school or university partway through the program.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{編入|へんにゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{短大|たんだい}→短大：28812_tandai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{四年制|よねんせい}⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三年次|さんねんじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{編入|へんにゅう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I transferred from a junior college into the third year of a four-year university.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{市町村|しちょうそん}→市町村：16065_shichouson⟧⟦{合併|がっぺい}→合併：04778_gappei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{編入|へんにゅう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That area was incorporated into the neighboring city through a municipal merger.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in educational contexts as {編入|へんにゅう}{学|がく} (transfer admission) or {編入|へんにゅう}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (transfer entrance exam). Also used in administrative and military contexts for incorporating units or territories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {編入|へんにゅう}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: transfer entrance examination
- {編入|へんにゅう}{学|がく}: transfer enrollment
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{編入|へんにゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be incorporated into
- {三年次|さんねんじ}{編入|へんにゅう}: third-year transfer
